$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/files.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context) writes file rows through apps/factory-api's platform/files, always through command(). The floor and partner roles only read, and only the files shared with them: the floor key is floorSiteId (set exactly when visibility has FLOOR), the partner key is partyId (set exactly when visibility has PARTNER or LINK); the guard trigger of the …_files_guards migration keeps both consistent with visibility. Neither sees the legal hold. No role deletes a row: a deleted file keeps its row in status DELETED, and the trigger refuses DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

StoredFile.about: The office requests uploads, confirms them, shares files, sets retention and legal holds, and deletes files (status DELETED); the worker will add generated documents. A floor device reads the files shared with its site's floor; a portal or link session reads the files shared with its party (the API also needs PARTNER for a portal session, and LINK and the link's record for a link).
